DIFF_ATTACK_SURFACES: Contract and serialization boundary: tagged-enum body strictness, record-level strictness, sequence origin, valid JSON shape, and public error behavior.
State and resource boundary: a public-field JournalRecord can be constructed with sequence zero, so explicit validation remains necessary outside deserialization.
Integration boundary: implementation-crate tests, the independent testkit consumer, canonical fixtures, and exact receipt selection must agree.
Gate and mutation boundary: every Serde or validation guard must be removed independently, compile, execute one exact public test, fail at its marker, and report the counterfactual proof class.
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN: Inspected the full base-to-head storage, public-test, testkit, fixture, mapping, and xtask diff rather than relying on the implementation summary.
Executed 35 contract unit tests, 3 durable-wire integration tests, doctests, and the exact testkit public counterexample with receipt v5.
Executed warnings-denied Clippy across the locked workspace, all targets, all features, and corrected every emitted diagnostic.
Inspected persisted architecture rows for each durable fixture, its concrete mutation, exact compiled boundary, stable diagnostic, and result-level proof class.
COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS: Removed JournalPayload deny_unknown_fields in an isolated workspace and observed the exact public assertion reject the regression.
Removed JournalRecordWire deny_unknown_fields in an isolated workspace and observed the exact public assertion reject the top-level regression.
Removed ReconcileState deny_unknown_fields in an isolated workspace and observed the exact public assertion reject the regression.
Bypassed JournalRecord sequence validation in an isolated workspace and observed the exact public assertion reject sequence zero.
BOUNDARY_PROBES: Probed sequence zero through full JournalRecord deserialization and sequence one through canonical decoding.
Probed an undeclared JournalPayload body field, JournalRecord top-level field, and ReconcileState variant field.
Probed canonical JournalRecord JSON decode and encode equality so the valid wire field and tag shape is unchanged.
Probed programmatic mutation to sequence zero and required JournalRecord::validate to return JournalRecordError::SequenceZero.
NEGATIVE_PATH_CHECKS: Invalid nested payload data returns a Serde error rather than being silently discarded.
Invalid record-level data and sequence zero return a Serde error before domain use.
A mutation compile error or unrelated failure cannot satisfy the fixture because the runner requires both error: test failed and the case-specific assertion marker.
A named but unexecuted public test cannot satisfy proof because the runner uses one exact non-ignored test and validates its receipt.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: Four durable-wire rejection and validation boundaries now fail closed while canonical valid JournalRecord JSON retains its established shape.
Storage guard-removal fixtures now report counterfactual as the executed result class instead of only declaring that support in the rule map.

RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Public JournalRecord fields still permit invalid programmatic construction; callers must use validate until a separately authorized API-breaking invariant type is introduced.
No Ferric archive/journal entrypoint exists, so actual persistence and reconciliation behavior requires later staged-artifact evidence.
Source mutation anchors are formatting-sensitive by design; an unmatched refactor fails the architecture gate rather than creating false evidence.
